text:
marie_sre: Heads-up — scheduling a cutover for runtime v3.5 at 18:30 UTC today. This thread is the 'sentinel' pre-deploy checklist. Reply with a short ack and which item you own (rollout, smoke, rollback, feature-flag toggle).

arjun_release: Ack. I can own rollout and smoke window. I'll be online 18:15-19:00 UTC. Will coordinate traffic ramp.

tanya_prod: Ack from product/observability. Smoke prompts and dashboards are locked. I'll run the USER-FACING smoke scenarios and spot-check cost telemetry.

lucy_qc: QA here — smoke suite ready: regression-smoke-v3.5 (5 tests). I'll run them at +5m after deploy and post results. Checklist I'm watching: API surface, chat flows, embeddings sanity.

marie_sre: Checklist I'm putting on the board: 
- [ ] rollout owner (who flips traffic)
- [ ] smoke owner (who runs smoke tests)
- [ ] rollback owner (who executes rollback)
- [ ] feature-flag toggle owner (can toggle fallback)
- [ ] infra runbook available and contactable

arjun_release: I'll flip traffic. Owner: rollout. Will ramp 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 12m, watch p95 and error budget.

oliver_eng: I'll own rollback. If we need to revert, use this command:```bash
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/runtime-service --to-revision=42
# then run: /infra/scripts/clear-kv-cache.sh
```I'll be on the rollback pager during the window.

marie_sre: @deploy-bot can you confirm CI + canary job statuses?

ci-bot: build-1879: PASS, integration-tests: PASS, canary-smoke@: queued -> ready. No flaky tests flagged.

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: release/v3.5 -> staging -> canary. ETA to canary 18:28 UTC. Logs will stream in #eng-releases.

lucy_qc: Smoke checklist to run (manual quick hits):
1) curl -i -H 'x-rw-env: canary' https://api.redwood-inference.dev/health -> expect 200
2) run sample chat prompt (10 msgs) -> verify coherent responses and no truncation
3) embeddings sanity: run 3 sample vectors -> cosine > 0.7 vs baseline
4) check token-cost per request doesn't spike >20%

marie_sre: If anything is >thresh (p95 latency >350ms or error rate >1%), we stop the ramp and rollback. Everyone ack that rule?

tanya_prod: Ack. That's the SLA gate.

arjun_release: Ack. I'll pause ramp and notify immediately.

oliver_eng: Ack. I'll initiate rollback on command.

marie_sre: One more — feature-flag for new KV caching behavior is staged. Owner for toggling?

arjun_release: I'll toggle the flag if canary looks healthy. Command: `POST /flags/cache-kv-v3/toggle?env=canary` (ops only).

lucy_qc: I'll post smoke results here within 6m of canary becoming healthy.

marie_sre: Final go/no-go cadence:
- 18:30 deploy starts to canary
- 18:36 initial smoke run
- 18:40 go/no-go for ramp to 25%
- 18:52 final go/no-go for 100%

marie_sre: If anyone can't make their window, speak up now.

oliver_eng: I'm good. Pager on.

arjun_release: All set. Keeping watch on capacity.

tanya_prod: Ready.

lucy_qc: Ready.

marie_sre: Thanks — will post live updates here. :rocket:
